name: BoE decision
consensus_source: No Reuters/Bloomberg poll found; only a mid-October prediction market priced a 25bp hike at 91.5% (not a poll)
read: BoE hiked 25bp to 4.0% from 3.75%, 8-1 with Mann wanting 50bp. Guidance conditional, not on a pre-set path. Hawkish for GBP and gilts. Vote from BoE page only, unconfirmed by a second source.

fields.guidance_tone: conditional hawkish hike; not on a pre-set path

reasons: no consensus available; surprise not assessed
